in_marathi.name: Chandragupt
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandragupt हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandragupta is a name derived from Sanskrit roots, where 'Chandra' refers to the moon and 'Gupt' means hidden or secret. This name is believed to have been given to a legendary emperor of the Maurya Empire in ancient India. The name symbolizes strength, power, and mystery, just like the moon itself.
